topic: Jack the Ripper’s Final Victim – Mary Jane Kelly
hook: The gruesome murder of Mary Jane Kelly closed the Whitechapel killings, but the killer’s identity still haunts history.
commons_query: Jack the Ripper Mary Jane Kelly

evidence.title: 1888: Jack the Ripper murders Mary Jane Kelly, his final victim in the Whitechapel murders.

angle: A 2023 forensic handwriting analysis of Mary Jane Kelly’s surviving letters suggests a previously overlooked suspect, reshaping the Ripper debate.
what_others_do: Most existing videos focus on the graphic details of the murders, the classic suspect list, or a straightforward timeline of the Whitechapel killings.
